Class DummyVirtualView

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.mesos.persistence.DummyVirtualView
All Implemented Interfaces:
VirtualView
public class DummyVirtualView extends Object implements VirtualView
A placeholder VirtualView used during replay for players who have not yet reconnected. The player will receive the updated state once they reconnect and the controller replaces this DummyVirtualView with their actual VirtualView.

    • showLeaderboard

      public void showLeaderboard(List<GameResult> leaderboard, int myPosition)
      Sends the global leaderboard stored in the server database to the client. This method is available only when the server database is enabled. The leaderboard contains the ranking of all players currently stored in the database, including the players who have just completed the game. This implementation discards the leaderboard.
      Specified by:
      showLeaderboard in interface VirtualView
      Parameters:
      leaderboard - the updated global leaderboard
      myPosition - the current player's position in the global ranking
